CustomField.formula: CASE( EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Global_Charges__r.Name , 'Tax', EYI_Charged_Amount__c, 'STAMP DUTY NON RECOVERABLE', EYI_Quote__r.Stamp_Duty__c , 'Registration Charges', IF( EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c < 3000000, (EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Charge_Percentage__c * EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c), 30000) , CASE( EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Charge_Calculated_As__c , 'Percentage of Agreement Value', (EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_Charge_Percentage__c * EYI_Quote__r.EYI_Agreement_Value__c), EYI_Calculated_Amount__c * VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(TEXT(EYI_Project_Charges__r.EYI_GST_Percentage__c), "GST-", "")) / 100))
